verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party docs say users can pay recipients over ACH and domestic wire, with optional approval controls, and can initiate those payouts via the API. A long-time customer independently reports reliable wire transfers, and there is bill-pay support for vendor payments. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of ACH vendor payouts specifically, detail on vendor recipient management and limits/fees for domestic payments.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors

citations.quote: Pay recipients from your Mercury accounts over ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire, with optional approval controls.
Initiate payouts directly from your systems via Mercury's API across ACH, check, domestic wire, and international wire.
AI reads bills, populates details automatically, and remembers past recipients — so you can approve and pay in seconds.
